postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU September 2025 no-postcode list includes Sint Maarten (Dutch part). The UPU country sheet and 2025 designated-operator list identify Postal Services Sint Maarten (PSS), but publish no postcode assignment. A shop ZIP field, administrative area, locality, AGID cell or generated SX draft code is not a PSS assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No postcode assignments exist to anchor postal Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Island, district, neighbourhood, locality, address, route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi, raster, AGID planning-cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Use recipient, street, house number, city and country separately. Region, district and neighbourhood may be retained only as independently typed context. Do not insert a fabricated postcode.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic identity and explicit relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. An island, locality, coordinate or synthetic SX code is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Existing generated SX planning cells and draft codes are simulation material and are never PSS codes or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The reviewed UPU, BTP and government bodies are reference evidence. No open postcode dataset or compatible processing, derivation, redistribution and public-serving licence is established.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO SX and Sint Maarten (Dutch part) identity. Do not merge it with Saint Martin (French part), Curaçao, Aruba, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba or the former Netherlands Antilles.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-postcode finding is time-dependent. Retain retrieval time, editions, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check only after the pending-country sweep or an official announcement.

stages.definition: Sint Maarten address-format inventory and generated synthetic planning material only.
Digest-bound UPU, BTP and Sint Maarten government no-postcode, operator, rights, address-format, identity and no-proxy evidence.

M2 requires a future current authoritative Postal Services Sint Maarten (PSS) or competent-public release establishing a Sint Maarten postcode system and a complete finite denominator of every assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area postal object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Current UPU evidence places Sint Maarten (Dutch part) in the September 2025 list of countries not requiring postal codes; absence is represented as none and does not itself satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon milestone. Any future drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. The island, districts, neighbourhoods, localities, addresses, routes, service areas, parcels, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells and generated SX planning codes are prohibited proxies. The approved immutable artifact must drive the real SX API/app, handle no-code/no-match/loading/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry states, fit and render translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear/re-search and display selected code, geometry kind, provenance class, source, reference date, confidence and linked postal/administrative/assertion/release IDs without asserting address or building authority.

agid_integration.current_scope: SX address metadata and no-postcode policy only; no real SX Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual SX loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Never manufacture a Sint Maarten postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, address or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified.
